value.name: Asha signals Rosa to bring someone down
value.description: Asha quietly tells Rosa to get the person downstairs immediately while hiding the folded sheet under her cuff.
evidence: Asha caught Rosa's eye across the desk and said, barely above breath, to get her down here now, sliding the folded sheet another few inches toward her own ribs so the paragraph naming the house sat hidden under her cuff and the angle of her body.

value.name: Rosa redirects Asha to the service stairs
value.description: Rosa does not immediately leave, instead quietly correcting Asha by pointing out that the service stairs are faster and glancing toward Daniel's route.
evidence: Rosa did not step away from the tray at once; she leaned a fraction toward Asha instead, fingertips still on the lacquer rim, and murmured that the service stairs were faster, with one sharp glance toward the hall where Daniel's footsteps had gone.

The suggestion landed as a small correction, the kind a person made who had been counting the house's shortcuts for thirty years, and Asha understood without answering that Rosa had already mapped the route before being asked.

value.name: Rosa heads to the back stairs
value.description: Rosa leaves the tray behind, smooths her apron, and moves through the inner doorway toward the back of the kitchen.
evidence: Rosa lifted her hand from the tray then, smoothed her apron once, and moved toward the inner doorway that gave onto the back of the kitchen, leaving the cup where she had set it as if she meant to come back to it.
value.location_hint: inner doorway to back of kitchen

value.name: Asha waits for footsteps downstairs
value.description: Asha stays in place, listening for the expected movement of two people coming down the stairs instead of one going up.
evidence: Asha kept her palm flat on the page and listened, past the ordinary creaks of the house, for two sets of footsteps coming down instead of one going up.

value.name: Asha hides the sheet under her cuff
value.description: After Rosa leaves, Asha glances toward the empty hall and fully conceals the folded sheet under her cuff.
evidence: As Rosa slipped through the inner doorway toward the back stairs, Asha lifted her hand from the corner of the page, glanced once at the empty hall where Daniel had gone, and slid the folded sheet the rest of the way under her cuff
